case_title: Nara Chandrababu Naidu v. The State of Andhra Pradesh & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused was implicated in a case involving the siphoning of public funds amounting to approximately Rs.370 crores. The case involved allegations of misappropriation of government funds through the establishment of a corporation and subsequent agreements with corporate entities. The accused was alleged to have unilaterally appointed individuals as MD and CEO without cabinet approval, leading to the approval of a budget for the project. The investigation revealed discrepancies in the project's financial management, including the use of shell companies and fake invoices. The accused was added as an accused in the FIR after an initial investigation into the matter. The case involved allegations of criminal breach of trust and fraud, with the accused being charged under multiple sections of the IPC and the Prevention of Corruption Act. The trial court remanded the accused to judicial custody, and the High Court dismissed the petition seeking quashing of the FIR and the remand order.
